description: Ranks USDC lending and tokenized-treasury yields across Solana, Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum (DefiLlama data) by risk-adjusted APY instead of headline APY. Each pool's APY is discounted for volatility, TVL depth, protocol risk, DefiLlama's stability prediction, reward-emission dependence and impermanent-loss exposure; every entry carries a riskScore (0-100), a riskFactors breakdown and riskNotes explaining the discount. Solana pools are marked executable (autoyield can prepare a deposit); other chains are informational. The response includes topExecutable (best risk-adjusted executable pool) and topByRiskAdjustedOverall (best across all chains); topByRiskAdjusted is a deprecated alias of topExecutable. Read-only.

amountUsdc.description: Optional intended deposit size for impact estimation

name: compare_yields

results.description: Pools ranked by risk-adjusted APY (protocol, chain, apy, riskAdjustedApy, riskScore, riskNotes, executable)

topByRiskAdjustedOverall.description: Best risk-adjusted pool across all chains

topExecutable.description: Best risk-adjusted pool autoyield can prepare deposits for
